sentences.text: The Carolina Panthers are a professional American football team based in Charlotte , North Carolina .	American football	American football

The Panthers compete in the National Football League -LRB- NFL -RRB- , as a member club of the league 's National Football Conference -LRB- NFC -RRB- South division .	National Football Conference	National Football Conference	National Football League	National Football League	South	NFC South

The club is worth approximately US$ 1.56 billion , according to Forbes , and is controlled by founder Jerry Richardson and his family , who have a 48 percent stake ; the remainder of the team is held by a group of 14 limited partners .	Jerry Richardson	Jerry Richardson	Forbes	Forbes	limited partners	Limited partnership
The team president is Danny Morrison , and the head coach is Ron Rivera .	Ron Rivera	Ron Rivera	Danny Morrison	Danny Morrison (sports executive)
The Panthers were announced as the league 's 29th franchise in 1993 , and began play in 1995 .	1995	1995 Carolina Panthers season

The Panthers played well in their first two years , finishing in 1995 -LRB- an all-time best for an NFL expansion team 's first season -RRB- and 12 -- 4 the following year , winning the NFC West before ultimately losing to the eventual Super Bowl champion Green Bay Packers in the NFC Championship Game .	1995	1995 Carolina Panthers season	NFC West	NFC West	Green Bay Packers	Green Bay Packers	NFC Championship Game	NFC Championship Game

They did not have another winning season until 2003 , when they won the NFC Championship Game and reached Super Bowl XXXVIII , losing 32 -- 29 to the New England Patriots .	2003	2003–04 NFL playoffs	NFC Championship Game	NFC Championship Game	Super Bowl XXXVIII	Super Bowl XXXVIII	New England Patriots	New England Patriots

After recording playoff appearances in 2005 and 2008 , the team failed to record another playoff appearance until 2013 , the first of three consecutive NFC South titles .	NFC South	NFC South	2008	2008–09 NFL playoffs	2013	2013–14 NFL playoffs	2005	2005–06 NFL playoffs	South	NFC South

After losing in the divisional round to the San Francisco 49ers in 2013 and the Seattle Seahawks in 2014 , the Panthers finally returned to the Super Bowl in 2016 , but lost to the Denver Broncos .	2013	2013–14 NFL playoffs	2014	2014–15 NFL playoffs	San Francisco 49ers	San Francisco 49ers	Seattle Seahawks	Seattle Seahawks	returned to the Super Bowl in 2016	Super Bowl 50	Denver Broncos	Denver Broncos
The Panthers have reached the playoffs seven times , advancing to four NFC Championship Games and two Super Bowls .
They have won six division titles , one in the NFC West and five in the NFC South .	NFC West	NFC West	NFC South	NFC South	South	NFC South

The team is headquartered in Bank of America Stadium in uptown Charlotte ; also the team 's home field .	Bank of America Stadium	Bank of America Stadium	uptown Charlotte	Charlotte center city	home field	Home (sports)
